name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A date field component that allows users to enter and edit date. The old month drifts out as the new one drifts in a beat later, the caption on its own layer; a picked day pops, a range sweeps in, and hovering after the first day previews the range with a ghost end; hover and focus fade. GPU-only.

theme.animate-godui-calendar-caption-in-from-s: godui-calendar-caption-in-from-start calc(var(--godui-duration-base) - var(--godui-calendar-caption-lag) * var(--godui-motion)) var(--ease-spring-snappy) calc((var(--godui-calendar-delay) + var(--godui-calendar-caption-lag)) * var(--godui-motion)) backwards
